meta.title: Improve offline demo resilience
meta.body_summary: Make optional dependencies (pandas, gradio, openai_agents) lazy-loaded with fallbacks; add CSV reading helper with pandas/csv dual path; skip demo UI if packages missing to improve offline resilience.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex made deps lazy; Copilot bot suggested tighter exception handling and CSV nrows=1; PR merged after applying all three suggestions.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 116 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, low-risk robustness PR and is consistent with the fast merge after incorporating review feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot recommended using ImportError instead of Exception for optional imports and suggested nrows=1 in pd.read_csv to limit I/O and memory usage.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve offline demo resilience by making dependencies optional, reducing crashes when packages missing.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Optional dependency handling and lazy imports are low-risk changes that Agent can implement with standard patterns; merge after applying automated review suggestions.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed import patterns and CSV reading approach, suggesting tighter exception handling and nrows=1 for efficiency.

core_change_summary.description: In alpha_detection.py, wrap pandas import in try/except with csv fallback; add _read_first_row helper with pandas/csv dual path. In agent_experience_entrypoint.py, make gradio and openai_agents optional with try/except, provide no-op Tool decorator, and skip demo launch if gr is None.
